{{note|ambassadors|1}} At the ambassadors meeting, Françoise and William agreed to cast the extra vote against David.<br />
{{note|final4|2}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in the ''Fallen Comrades'' challenge, where the castaway with<br />the fewest correct answers would be eliminated. Since Romain had the fewest correct answers, he was eliminated.
